summary: Verified all UI features in the latest Desync batch: admin Products category-nav, drag handles, per-product Discord URL + Instructions fields with https:// validation, KeyManager scrollable filtered list, storefront rich RichDescription (headings/bold/checkmark bullets), and /orders OTP two-step flow (send code, wrong-code error, resend + use-different-email links). Backend pytest suite (16 tests across test_otp_reorder.py + test_desync_features.py) re-run and passes.

design_issues.screen: Admin Dashboard header — Sales by product widget
issues: React 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings spam the console: multiple orders reference deleted products which all render as 'Deleted product' and appear to be keyed by name/label instead of a stable id. Cosmetic (no visual dupes seen) but pollutes console and is a latent duplicate-key hazard.

action_items: In the admin 'Sales by product' list, key each row by order/product id (or index) rather than product name to eliminate the duplicate-key React warnings for 'Deleted product' rows.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin Products category-nav (ProductsTab.jsx) correctly wires data-testid admin-cat-card-<slug>, admin-cat-back, admin-add-product-button, admin-add-account-button, drag-handle-<id>, admin-product-row-<id>, admin-edit/delete/keys-button-<id> — good testability.
ProductForm Discord URL client validation returns clear toast 'Discord URL must start with https://' AND backend enforces it (400 seen for the same submit) — defense in depth is good.
KeyManager 'keys-list' uses overflow-y:auto with max-height ≈ 410px (38vh @ 1080p) and shows correct '<n> total' counter (40 for PHANTOM). Filter narrows rows visibly.
ProductModal 'modal-description' renders rich content (h4 headings, <strong> bold lead-ins, checkmark bullet lines) directly under the product image on the left column — matches spec.

OrderLookup two-step flow works: lookup-email-input + lookup-submit-button → otp-code-input + otp-verify-button; toasts 'Code sent — check your inbox' and 'Incorrect code' render; Resend code + Use a different email links present.
server.py already flagged in iteration_1 as ~1000+ lines — still worth splitting into routers; not a blocker.

seed_data_creation: None (a temporary edit set PHANTOM discord_url='http://bad.example.com' was rejected by validation and immediately restored to blank; PHANTOM discord_url ends at empty string, its original value).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new-batch UI features (category-nav admin products, drag handles, discord_url/instructions fields+validation, KeyManager scroll/filter, ProductModal RichDescription, /orders OTP two-step) are functional on preview URL. Only lingering issue is a benign React duplicate-key warning in the admin 'Sales by product' widget when multiple 'Deleted product' rows are rendered — key each row by id. Backend pytest already covers OTP verify-success (which UI cannot verify since the email inbox is unreachable in-test).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. The duplicate-key React warning stems from the admin dashboard rendering the sales-by-product breakdown keyed by the product's display name; when several orders reference now-deleted products they all resolve to the string 'Deleted product', producing collisions.
